title: Los pollitos dicen
attribution: Children's song by the Chilean teacher, poet and musician Ismael Parraguez (1883-1917), published as "Los pollitos" in his Poesías infantiles (1907); he died more than 100 years ago and the song was published before 1929, so melody and words are public domain. Melody checked against the score and MIDI at Mama Lisa's World (transposed from A to G).
